infotexts.JobDescription.engineer_arcane: An engineer who reads runes as circuit diagrams. Keeps the engineer talent tree and gains an additional charge branch.
infotexts.JobDescription.engineer_mystic: Something lives inside the reactor, and you have signed its contract. Keeps the engineer talent tree and gains an additional radiation branch.
infotexts.entitydescription.Touhou_Engineer_Arcane: Hold in both hands and press Use or Aim. Requires a vanilla engineer with both primary talent stages completed and Magic skill 80. Consumed only on success. Registers the Charge Engineer transition. Applies next round, or to a newly spawned engineer body after death. One completed transition per player per campaign.
infotexts.entitydescription.Touhou_Engineer_Mystic: Hold in both hands and press Use or Aim. Requires a vanilla engineer with both primary talent stages completed and Medical skill 60. Consumed only on success. Registers the Radiation Engineer transition. Applies next round, or to a newly spawned engineer body after death. One completed transition per player per campaign.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_EngineerTransit: Effect-free placeholder. Tests job transitions, talent selection, points and persistence. Grants no stats, recipes or active abilities.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_ArcaneEngineer_: Crafted items gain +1 quality; repair speed +20%.
Electrical devices you repair deteriorate at half speed.
Repair speed +20%, hull repair speed +20%, experience gain +20%.
Danmaku attacks have a chance to inflict electric shock and burn.
Attacks have a chance to inflict extra stun and electric shock.
+10% max health. Each point of Electrical skill grants 0.05% all attack damage, up to +10%.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_MysticEngineer_: Turret power consumption -15%; turrets you operate deal +5% damage.
Ranged attacks have a chance to inflict a small amount of radiation sickness and burn.
Crafted items gain +1 quality; while above 50% health, slowly recover some injuries.
Deal increased damage to enemies with radiation sickness; the higher their radiation sickness, the greater the bonus, up to +15%.
